newsitem.title: USA: Shareholders approve Ultramar, Diamond Merger.
newsitem.headline: Shareholders approve Ultramar, Diamond Merger.

text.p: Diamond Shamrock Inc and Ultramar Corp on Tuesday said shareholders from each firm have approved the $850 million stock-swap merger, finalizing the formation of Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp.
The new firm, which will be the fourth largest independent refining and marketing company in North America, will trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "UDS," they said.

In the merger, each share of Diamond Shamrock common stock is being converted into 1.02 shares of Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Common Stock. Shares of Ultramar outstanding prior to the merger remain outstanding after the merger.
Ultramar Diamond Shamrock vice chairman and president Jean Gaulin said in a statement the new corporation's emphasis will be on its refining and marketing business.
"Ultramar Diamond Shamrock has a unique strategic advantage in being able to supply growing Southwest markets from either its California or Texas refineries," Gaulin said.
The firm's board will consist of six persons from each of the two predecessor boards. Roger Hemminghaus will serve as chairman and chief executive.
